text:
Maria - CS: Heads up — collected 7 asks from LumenHealth & CoveBank during onboarding this week. dropping a quick list here and requesting pruning/priority before I push to product board. TL;DR: billing per-route visibility, faster embeddings indexing, session export for audit.
Lucy - CSM: Adding quick notes on impact: LumenHealth renewal in 30 days, CoveBank pilot goes live in 2 weeks.
Ken - Support: I've got a support thread for CoveBank complaining about long time-to-first-token on dedicated — likely small config issue. pinging @Aj.
Aj - Eng: on it. can you paste repro? also any logs?
Maria - CS: Pasted link to sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EXAMPLE (notes + raw quotes). includes customer quotes and suggested priority.
Sam - PM: Thanks. can we run a very small triage rubric? ask severity, frequency, revenue impact, implementation effort. propose scoring 1-5 and threshold for 'ship this sprint' >=12.
Lucy - CSM: Agree. i'll score LumenHealth: severity 4, freq 3, revenue 5, effort 2 => 14
Ken - Support: CoveBank: severity 3, freq 4, revenue 3, effort 3 => 13
Aj - Eng: From eng POV effort for session export is 4, but embedding index speed tweak maybe 2 if we increase batch size and enable cache.
Sam - PM: Ok. i'll flag 'session export' as P1 for next minor release. embedding perf — let's run A/B on dedicated with caching config first.
TriageBot: TriageBot: Added tags: customer-ask, renewal-risk, pilot-account. Created ticket PROD-4283.
Maria - CS: :thumbsup: can someone own prepping a 1-pager for the sales rep at LumenHealth?
Lucy - CSM: I'll take it — will draft and share by EOD.
Aj - Eng: FYI snippet of config we might push to CoveBank to reduce TTF token:
```yaml
kv_cache: enabled
batching:
  max_batch: 32
```
Ken - Support: I'll drop that in the support thread and collect results.
Sam - PM: Great. Also: we should add a checkbox in CS intake form for 'renewal at risk' so these get auto-prioritized. @Maria can you add?
Maria - CS: Yep — created a GH issue on the intake form repo: https://github.com/redwood/intake/issues/58
TriageBot: TriageBot: Linked PROD-4283 to intake-58.
Maria - CS: Thanks team. I'll update the sheet after Lucy's 1-pager. if no objections we'll present to roadmap sync Friday.
